QuestInfo.name: [Heroes] The Fight Ends
QuestInfo.2:
Alicia, the Transcendent of Life, scattered herself across the world to restore the devastatation. New sprouts budded from the dry earth, and the sun and rivers regained their original form. A mural of the battle was engraved in the ruins of the ancients.

Evan and Mir were born again as true heroes, and they set off on a new adventure.
